comment: Single source of truth for the bundled Python runtime's package set. Read by scripts/setup-python-runtime.mjs (pip pins), src/main/python/python-scripting-doc.test.ts (the docs table must list every entry), and src/main/python/python-worker.test.ts (every importName must import inside the sandboxed worker). The set is the union of the script-facing packages in Wallace's three sample environments (ip26, IP4AI_2023, opencvlarge, July 2026) at the newest sample version; entries whose sample pin cannot run on this runtime (CPython 3.12, numpy 2) carry the nearest compatible release and a bumpedFrom note. IDE tooling from those environments (Spyder, Jupyter, linters, Qt, Sphinx) is deliberately not bundled.
